responsibility: This file implements GCC’s higher-level option semantics and diagnostics-facing utilities for common options after basic parsing. It owns logic for interpreting and reporting debug information format selections and struct-debug suboptions, computing user-visible option names and documentation URLs for diagnostics, and generating command-line / producer strings that record a filtered summary of effective switches for emitted debug metadata such as DW_AT_producer; in other words, it is the policy layer that turns parsed option state into debug-format configuration, diagnostic metadata, and reproducible command-line descriptions.
same_name_distinction: Implements a subset of the option subsystem APIs declared in gcc/opts.h, focusing on post-parsing option semantics such as debug-format selection, diagnostic option naming/URLs, and DWARF producer/command-line string generation. Unlike gcc/opts.h, it is not the central metadata/type declaration point for options and generated tables, but the runtime policy code that consumes that interface.
